name: Alpha quartz
notes: Ambient cell and compression are from Angel et al., Journal of Applied Crystallography 30, 461-466 (1997), doi:10.1107/S0021889897000861. Fractional coordinates are the 298 K refinement of Kihara, European Journal of Mineralogy 2, 63-77 (1990), doi:10.1127/ejm/2/1/0063, COD 9005017. Phase-line intensities were calculated from the cited structure using independent-atom X-ray form factors.

eos_records.label: Angel et al. (1997), single-crystal BM3
eos_records.notes: Third-order Birch-Murnaghan fit to 22 single-crystal measurements from ambient pressure to 8.9 GPa at room temperature. The range describes the fitted data, not the alpha-quartz stability field.
